tasks.label: Run scripts (mock backend)
tasks.command: if [ -d .venv-mock ]; then .venv-mock/bin/python scripts/mock_backend.py --host 0.0.0.0 --ws-port 81 --http-port 8081; else python3 -m venv .venv-mock && .venv-mock/bin/pip install -r scripts/requirements-mock.txt && .venv-mock/bin/python scripts/mock_backend.py --host 0.0.0.0 --ws-port 81 --http-port 8081; fi
